videos.description:
5 Claude skills I'd set up before doing any real coding with Claude Code 👇

1. verification-before-completion: Claude can't say "done" until it runs the command that proves it and reads the output. (obra/superpowers)

2. systematic-debugging: no fixes until it finds the root cause. No more five random patches for the same bug. (obra/superpowers)

3. git-guardrails-claude-code: a hook blocks git push, reset --hard and force-deleting branches before Claude can run them. You're not asking it to be careful. The command just doesn't run. (mattpocock/skills)
